# World Nuclear News: Cold testing of Chinese SMR completed

Published: 16 Oct 2025.

## Key Findings
- **ACP100 (Linglong One)** cold functional tests completed at **Changjiang site, Hainan province**.
- Announced by **China National Nuclear Corporation (CNNC)**.
- Cold functional tests verify leak-tightness of primary circuit (pressure vessels, pipelines, valves) and clean main circulation pipes.
- First time reactor systems operated together with auxiliary systems.
- **125 MWe integrated PWR** (pressurized water reactor).
- First concrete poured: **13 Jul 2021**. Planned construction: **58 months**.
- Equipment installation commenced Dec 2022. Reactor building internal structure completed Mar 2023. Containment dome hoisted Feb 2025.
- Site already has: 2 operating CNP600 PWRs + 2 Hualong One units (due commercial operation by end 2026).
- **2016**: ACP100 design became **first SMR to pass IAEA safety review**.
- Once completed: **1 billion kWh annually**, enough for **526,000 households**.
- Next steps: hot trials, reactor loading, commercial operation.
